notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.27.1:

- Fixed a crash ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading bg)') that could occur when a critical note or finding had an unexpected severity value (e.g. from an imported file with different casing). All severity/status colour lookups now fall back to a safe default instead of throwing.
- Previously: Add Row on the DSPM + FDC Agent tabs now persists; wider Product Lifecycle sidebar with wrapping product names.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
